patch.value: Detect existing duplicate items with calibrated pair decisions

Add bounded title and body lexical candidates, sequential typed pair verification, abstention and explicit SDK apply/close receipts. Measure lexical and local model arms on public duplicate closures with held-out labels.

Evaluate public tracker-copy duplicate closures versus lexical hard controls, using disjoint duplicate groups and a maximum of 200 pairs per local model arm. Canonical checkouts and external data remain read-only.

value.text: Finish-round assessment against the task contract: the merged scan (trigram candidate retrieval, calibrated same_work pair decisions, receipts, apply/close guards) covers most of the contract, but two spec gaps remain.
